answer: Because the timing is written down against the wander challenge, the echo audit can replay the river history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm thus has to pad 193 submissions and hold each identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 3858 identities would post 1694 proofs and burn roughly 11 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
